label: FREE TOOL
headline: Mailchimp: Stay connected with your audience
body: Build an email list and send newsletters about your latest creations, offers, or behind-the-scenes updates to keep your community engaged.
caption:
Email marketing is a powerful way to build a direct relationship with your audience. Mailchimp's free plan allows you to start building your list and sending regular updates without upfront cost. It’s perfect for creators and small businesses to share news, promotions, or just say hello. Remember to check their website for the most current free plan limits and features. Ready to connect? 👋
